title: ficus microcarpa var. rigo
intro: Ficus microcarpa var. rigo, commonly known as the Chinese banyan or Malabar chestnut, is a variety of the Ficus microcarpa species. Research has shown that the Ficus microcarpa var. rigo plant has numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The plant is believed to have therapeutic actions such as sedation and anxiolysis due to its ability to modulate the nervous system and reduce anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Ficus microcarpa var. rigo include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
